label: مواقف مركز تسوق
setting: in a shopping center parking lot
parking: Stationary squarely inside an actual marked parking bay, wheels straight, leaving access lanes clear; no invented curb-to-wheel gap.
ground: Faded dusty patched asphalt or marked parking concrete, subdued weak reflections.
background: Local everyday storefront, access path or wall matching the selected location, naturally passing people or parked cars only if visible; no landmark.
angleReason: A standing arm-length selfie by the legally parked vehicle retains face dominance without widening for the car.
goldenPeriod: soft morning or late-afternoon natural light

day.source: Single natural sun or diffuse sky, 5500K, shadows oriented consistently away from its actual position; natural muted paint and glass reflections.
day.shadows: Away from the physically present daylight source; natural contact shade.
day.reflections: Limited realistic daylight reflections on pearl-white paint and automotive glass.

night.source: One actual nearby entrance or street fixture, 3000K, shadows opposite its direction, restrained reflections.
night.shadows: Away from the one established dominant night source, or subdued when only sky is present.
night.reflections: Localized weak highlights on pearl-white paint and glass, no studio fill.
